notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello humans! ːcathspawː

We're thrilled to unveil an exciting new adventure! Introducing "An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble," an expansion that will be released on November 16th, alongside "An Arcade Full of Cats". 
This DLC is not just a thrilling addition to the base game but also a heartfelt celebration of a very special month for us. ːfofinoː

As November rolls around, it is time to celebrate two incredible anniversaries that hold a special place in our hearts: it marks the cherished moment when Fofiño and Leo entered our lives (2015 and 2022, respectively) – and it's also the anniversary of "A Castle Full of Cats"! ːfofino2ː

In order to celebrate this extra special time and to show our gratitude for everyone who embarked in this journey with us, we'll be giving "An Arcade Full of Cats" as a free game! It began as a small game, but it has grown beyond our expectations – the base game is even bigger than "A Building Full of Cats"! 


[b]"Timewarp Trouble" - An Adventure Like No Other[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582360/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats_TimeWarp_Trouble/

"An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble" offers a twist in the ideas of "An Arcade Full of Cats". In this expansion, Leo and Fofiño find themselves venturing too deep into the past, encountering cats from Pre-History, the Georgian Age, and the Old West. Your mission isn't just to search for lost cats; you'll also be running errands for cats from each era! Meet Joe, Louie and Lybica – they'll be your guides throughout this exciting adventure.

[b]Timewarp Trouble[/b] Features:

[list]
[*] [b]New Time Eras:[/b] Dive into Pre-History, the Georgian Age and The Old West, each with its unique challenges and adorable cats to rescue.

[*] [b]Time-Bending Tasks:[/b] Complete various errands for cats from different time periods, adding an exciting twist to your adventure.

[*] [b]Meet New Friends:[/b] Get to know Joe, Louie and Lybica – your companions on this time-travelling cat rescue mission.

[*] [b]Original Soundtrack: [/b]Immerse yourself in the captivating world of "Timewarp Trouble" with our new original music.
[/list]

Get ready to experience a time-travelling quest that will challenge your skills, touch your heart and make history one era at a time. "An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble" awaits your adventurous spirit!

Join us on November 16th and uncover hidden feline friends, conquer challenging tasks and rewrite cat history in the process! Just don't overdo it, ok? ːwinkycatː

Thank you for being part of our incredible community and we can't wait to share this new adventure with you!

Love & Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
